description:
About our brand and products:
Advance Skin Tech offers advanced at-home LED beauty and skincare technology designed to help improve skin appearance, support anti-aging, reduce blemishes, and elevate self-care routines. Our collection includes LED light therapy devices, facial rejuvenation tools, beauty tech accessories, and skin-focused wellness devices that bring professional-style treatments into everyday routines.

What makes us different:
We focus on accessible, technology-driven beauty solutions that combine innovation, convenience, and results. Our products are designed for customers who want spa-inspired skincare treatments from home without expensive appointments or invasive procedures. We prioritize trending beauty technology, aesthetic product design, and easy-to-use devices that fit naturally into modern skincare and wellness routines.

How affiliates can earn:
Affiliates earn 14% commission on every qualifying order through custom affiliate links and coupon codes. With a 30-day cookie window, affiliates can continue earning commissions from customers who purchase after their initial visit. Our products are highly visual and perform especially well in beauty, skincare, wellness, and lifestyle content.

How to promote us:
Our products work especially well through:

  • TikTok skincare routines and transformations

  • Instagram Reels and beauty demos

  • LED mask and red light therapy content

  • “Beauty tech” and “Amazon find” style videos

  • Anti-aging and glow-up content

  • Before-and-after skincare journeys

  • Wellness, self-care, and luxury-at-home routines

  • UGC and creator-style tutorials

Video content showing product use, routines, and visible skin improvements tends to convert best.

Other information:

  • 14% commission per sale

  • 30-day tracking cookie

  • Affiliate links and coupon support available

  • Ideal audience: beauty, skincare, wellness, anti-aging, and self-care shoppers

  • Creator-friendly brand open to long-term partnerships

  • Worldwide affiliate applications accepted where available
